import sys
from bisect import bisect_right

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    H = [0] * n
    L = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        H[i] = int(data[idx]); L[i] = int(data[idx + 1])
        idx += 2
    # suffix max of heights
    suf = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        suf[i] = H[i] if H[i] > suf[i + 1] else suf[i + 1]
    q = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        t = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        p = bisect_right(L, t)
        out.append(str(suf[p]))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")

def _parse(inp):

        idx += 2
    q = int(t[idx]); idx += 1
    T = [int(x) for x in t[idx:idx + q]]
    return n, H, L, q, T, t
